## Slate overview
**Tottenham v Coventry, 3:00 PM ET (USA Network).** Kalshi prices: Spurs 65%, draw 21-25%, Coventry 15% ([Covers](https://www.covers.com/soccer/tottenham-vs-coventry-city-prediction-picks-oct-19-2026)). Spurs are 19th (3 pts, winless, 3 wins in their last 25 EPL home games). Coventry are 14th (6 pts) and won their last two, including 4-1 over Newcastle.

## Best bets
### Coventry double chance (draw or Coventry, i.e. +0.5): take +130 (2.30) or better, 0.5 units
- **Win probability 47% vs. 43.5% implied at +130.** The market prices draw-or-Coventry at about 36-40%.
- **Two independent models are far below the market on Spurs:** Squawka has Spurs 46 / draw 25 / Coventry 29, a +14-point value gap on Coventry ([Squawka](https://www.squawka.com/us/news/premier-league/match-preview-tottenham-vs-coventry-city-19-10-26-premier-league/)). Opta has Spurs 51.4 / Coventry 23.9 ([The Analyst](https://theanalyst.com/articles/premier-league-match-predictions)). Covers's author's top pick is the draw.
- **Team-news reason (Oct 16 and Oct 18 lessons):** Spurs are without Simons, Odobert and Mudryk, Bentancur is suspended, and Porro and Kulusevski are doubtful. They've scored 3 goals in 6 games. Coventry are without Amenda, Wright, Eccles and Woolfenden, and Awoniyi is suspended.
- **Risk:** Coventry's injury list is also long. If double chance isn't available at +130, Coventry +0.5 Asian handicap is the same bet. Don't take the Coventry moneyline.

## Leans & passes
- **Under 2.5:** pass. Squawka shows 51% vs. 39% market, but goals markets are unproven for us.

## Risks
- Check whether Porro and Kulusevski start.

picks.summary: Opta (24%) and Squawka (29%) rate Coventry far above 15% market; Spurs winless and missing four attackers/mids.
